parts: Big-Foot de Thalek Mystery Of The World
White and red Male born on June 15, 2013.
DNA-identified at the Société Centrale Canine. Confirmed in France.
Mother DNA-identified at the Real Sociedad Canina de España.
From the cross of our latest import Feel The Angel (Dandy) with our beautiful Spanish, Portuguese and International Champion Ghost In Love (Chanel), this beautiful dog was born.

He is living with our dear friends Stéphanie Duronssoy, Jérome Gaschet and their Shih Tzu in France. We thank them for their trust in us, our dogs and our breeding methods, and for acquiring Mystery to show him in Europe.
We hope and wish that his show career will be successful and that we will soon hear news of him at shows, and above all that he will be very, very happy with his new parents.
